items.excerpt: Matrimony.com Q2 Billings Update • Q2 FY27 consolidated billings rose 10.7% YoY to ₹131.09 Cr. • H1 FY27 billings increased 9.2% YoY to ₹267.11 Cr. • Matchmaking Services contributed ₹130.30 Cr in Q2, up from ₹117.51 Cr YoY. • Matchmaking Services billings stood at ₹265.59 Cr in H1 FY27 vs ₹242.82 Cr YoY. • Marriage Services & Others contributed ₹0.79 Cr in Q2 and ₹1.52 Cr in H1. • Numbers are unaudited and subject to limited review and approval by the Audit Committee and Board.
